feature.title: Reflexive semantic ambiguity and crisis-lifecycle guard

purpose: Block ambiguous semantic correction and undefined crisis lifecycle execution while preserving every contradictory source formula.

required.statement: Expose positive operator/social signs and the negative adaptive-gradient sign simultaneously.

forbidden.statement: Do not silently choose a sign convention, repair the source, or invent a crisis state machine.

deferred.statement: Semantic correction convention and crisis lifecycle require explicit external providers.

operations.purpose: Classify requested semantics and reject unsupported ambiguous execution.

inputs.name: scientific_inputs
inputs.semantic_role: request descriptor and optional explicit semantic/lifecycle providers

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantic_role: semantic ambiguity and lifecycle guard assessment

preconditions.statement: The contradictory source formulas and requested semantic intent are available.

postconditions.statement: Literal source-expression access remains distinguishable from semantic correction and crisis lifecycle requests.

invariants.statement: No contradictory source formula is suppressed or promoted silently.

steps: require lifecycle provider for crisis operations

partial_order.before: require lifecycle provider for crisis operations

error_contract.condition: Semantic dissonance correction is requested without an explicit external sign convention or provider.
Crisis lifecycle behavior is requested without an external lifecycle provider.

implementation_modes.statement: Reject semantic correction or lifecycle execution when the source does not select the required semantics.

global_invariants.statement: Positive and negative source signs remain jointly traceable and no formula wins silently.

notes: This package is the required sign-ambiguity and crisis-lifecycle non-execution guard.
